name: Watermelon Mojito
steps: Remove any seeds from watermelon, cube the flesh and blend it until smooth; strain only if a pulp-free drink is wanted.
Divide mint and lime wedges among four glasses. Press gently a few times to release their aroma without tearing the leaves.
Add watermelon purée, lime juice and syrup to the glasses, then 100 g ice in each; stir from the bottom.
Top each with 120 ml chilled club soda and serve immediately while the fizz and fresh watermelon flavour last.
tips: Ripe watermelon is usually sweet enough; taste it before using all the syrup.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
